sections.Profile:
"Majorettes," produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1964, is an Add-A-Ball electro-mechanical pinball machine known for its simple yet strategic gameplay. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, it features a straightforward layout with 10 bumpers and a unique hole between the flippers that can kick the ball back into play.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1964
